# Expert Tech

> Expert Tech provides proactive managed IT support, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and bespoke software engineering for businesses across Scotland and the United Kingdom. Registered in Scotland with headquarters in Cowdenbeath, Fife.

## Key Technical Commitments & SLAs
- **Average Emergency Response SLA**: 15 minutes guaranteed for priority incidents.
- **Uptime Assurance**: 99.9% infrastructure availability SLA.
- **Monitoring**: 24/7/365 proactive automated endpoint, server, and network health tracking.
- **Data Sovereignty**: 100% UK data residency (AWS London, Microsoft Azure UK South, UK sovereign private clouds), fully compliant with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
- **Contracts**: Transparent rolling monthly agreements with 30-day notice; milestone-based custom software delivery.

## Core Services
- [Managed IT Support & Helpdesk](https://experttech.co.uk/services): Proactive remote diagnostics, 15-minute SLA triage, on-site Scottish escalation, Microsoft 365 administration.
- [Cloud Solutions & DevOps](https://experttech.co.uk/services): AWS and Azure architecture, zero-downtime data migration, automated disaster recovery, hourly backups, cost optimization.
- [Web Design & Development](https://experttech.co.uk/services): Next.js, React, TypeScript, secure API integrations, WCAG 2.1 accessibility, SEO optimization.
- [Software & App Development](https://experttech.co.uk/services): Bespoke internal CRM systems, workflow automation, iOS and Android apps, database architecture.
- [Cybersecurity & Compliance](https://experttech.co.uk/services): Perimeter defense, vulnerability audits, Cyber Essentials alignment, UK GDPR governance.
- [Network & Systems Architecture](https://experttech.co.uk/services): Structured cabling, enterprise Wi-Fi, VoIP telephony, secure site-to-site VPNs.
